args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@Gideon Sato here's the draft for Mateo's procurement team, pulled from #inc-vtg-hartford and the SUP-5380 ticket log. Times are Central, Aug 3, 2026.

*Hartford gate kiosks incident summary (Vantorre Group, VTG)*
- *Tracking:* SUP-5380 (Sev 1), incident room #inc-vtg-hartford; INC-4821 for the status-page access issue
- *First report:* 10:42 AM. Both inbound gate kiosks showed a white screen after badge scan; the guard was checking trucks in by hand.
- *Kiosk 1 back:* 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch could see it.
- *Both lanes confirmed working:* 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM by Gideon).
- *Still open:* Mateo's login to the status page still shows "access denied"; his admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see arrivals. Kiosk 2 is being left powered on for Carrowmere Cloud's gateway-route reconnect logs, and the root cause is still being checked.

One thing to confirm before this goes out: the SUP-5380 update log has an earlier entry at 08:12 AM ("reboot failed, drivers queueing"). If that counts as the first report, the summary should say 08:12 AM rather than 10:42 AM. I used 10:42 because it is the first post in the incident room.

I posted the draft summary in #strategic-random, addressed to you.

Before it goes to Mateo, please confirm the first-report time. The incident room starts at 10:42 AM, but the SUP-5380 ticket log has an earlier entry at 08:12 AM ("reboot failed, drivers queueing"). I used 10:42 AM in the draft and noted the 08:12 AM entry in the same post.

- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM (Mateo confirmed trailer 8836 checked in).
- **Both lanes confirmed working:** 11:07 AM (your 11:08 AM post).

The draft is operational only, with no finance figures. Nothing has been sent to Mateo.

Finish Gideon's summary: add that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile) was checking the gateway route and that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. Post the final version in here as its own message starting with 'FINAL:'.

FINAL: @Ruth Calloway, here is the finished Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team. Times are Central, Aug 3, 2026.

*Hartford gate kiosks incident summary (Vantorre Group, VTG)*
- *Tracking:* SUP-5380 (Sev 1), incident room #inc-vtg-hartford. Status-page access is tracked in INC-4821.
- *First report (incident room):* 10:42 AM. Both inbound gate kiosks showed a white screen after badge scan; the guard was checking trucks in by hand.
- *Kiosk 1 back:* 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch could see it.
- *Both lanes confirmed working:* 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM by Gideon).
- *Still open:* Mateo's login to the status page still shows "access denied"; his admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see arrivals. Status-page access is tracked in INC-4821.
- *Root cause:* Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route. Kiosk 2 is being left powered on for their reconnect logs.

Open point: SUP-5380's update log has an earlier entry at 08:12 AM ("reboot failed, drivers queueing"). The first-report time above is the first post in the incident room and has not been confirmed against that entry.

@Ruth Calloway correction to the FINAL summary above: it should say "Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) is checking the Hartford gateway route" under the gateway item, not "Root cause." No root cause has been identified yet. Also, INC-4821 appears twice; the status-page line is the only place it should be.

I posted the FINAL summary in #strategic-random, as its own message starting with "FINAL:".

It includes the two items you asked for: Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) checking the gateway route, and status-page access tracked in INC-4821.

The FINAL post has two mistakes, and I've posted a correction in the channel:
- I labelled the gateway item "Root cause." Odile only said they were checking the route, so no root cause has been identified.
- INC-4821 appears twice. The status-page line is the only place it belongs.

The correction is a separate message, so the FINAL post itself still contains both errors. Please use the corrected wording if you forward it.

The 08:12 AM entry in SUP-5380 is still unresolved. The summary gives 10:42 AM as the first report, the first post in the incident room, and flags that it hasn't been checked against the 08:12 entry. Someone needs to confirm which one Mateo should see before it goes out.

Nothing has been sent to Mateo.
